slides.title: Condo or plex? 5 Laval differences to weigh
slides.sub: Same goal: rental income. Two very different buys. Here's how they compare in Laval.

photo.credit: Rivière des Prairies, Pont-Viau · Photo: Natthager, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: The entry price: about double
slides.body: A Laval plex costs about **twice** a condo. But you get more than one unit, and more than one rent.

slides.title: Fewer plexes change hands
slides.body: Same selling time, but far fewer plexes trade in Laval. Expect **less choice** and more patience when you shop.

slides.title: Who pays when the roof leaks?
slides.body: Condo owners share big repairs through fees. In a plex, the roof, foundation and snow removal are **yours alone**.
slides.source: Per CMHC Québec condo fact sheet, November 2026

slides.title: Renting it out: different rules
slides.body: You notify the syndicate when you rent a condo, and **short-term rentals** can be banned. Read the declaration first.

slides.title: Plex prices shift by sector
slides.body: A **$119K gap** across three sectors. Compare solds on your target street, not the Laval average.

slides.title: Weighing a condo or a plex? Let's talk.
slides.tagline: I'll give it to you straight, no arrogance, no fluff.
